name: The Breakdown
controllingIdea: Complex processes become manageable when broken into understandable pieces.

narrativeArc.incitingIncident: A common question, confusion, or misconception identified
narrativeArc.crisis: The tricky part that most people miss or get wrong
narrativeArc.climax: The key insight that changes everything
narrativeArc.resolution: Empowered audience ready to act with confidence

promptConfig.systemContext: This is an educational piece. The agent positions as a helpful teacher. Focus on clarity, simplicity, and genuine value. Avoid jargon.
promptConfig.toneGuidance: Friendly expert explaining to a friend. Patient, clear, not condescending. Make complex things simple.

slideStructure.contentFocus: Save this / share / ask me more

usageHints: Great for evergreen content that can be reused
Keep each slide to ONE concept

exampleScenarios.title: What Happens After Your Offer is Accepted
exampleScenarios.sampleInput: Clients always wonder what happens between offer acceptance and closing. I want to explain the inspection period, appraisal, and clear-to-close steps in simple terms.

expectedOutput.hook: Offer accepted. Now what? Here's exactly what happens next.
expectedOutput.keyMoment: The inspection period is your last easy exit. Use it wisely.
